sources.notes: YENI KESIF (Brave Search). Caterpillar + PACCAR fault code liste/kaynaklari: (1) caterpillarfaultcodes.com = MID/CID/EID/FMI tam liste + SPN; (2) jimcontent CAT PDF = Truck/Tractor/Excavator/Loader/Grader/Pipelayer DTC (SPN-FMI); (3) jimcontent PACCAR PDF = sd95d2cbd361a0b8d.jimcontent.com/.../PACCAR MX-13 Fault Codes DTC.pdf (truck-manuals.net); (4) stronglaptop = CAT PID/SID/FMI PDF; (5) mechnician = PACCAR SPN list; (6) 30minutedpfclean = PACCAR MX13. Hedef: J1939 SPN/FMI (Cat + PACCAR).

YENI KESIF. OBDb org = arac-bazli acik OBD DB (topluluk). Her arac icin PID/signal tanimlari (DTC degil). CC-BY-SA-4.0. Proje src/protocols/obd + DbcSignalDecoder icin signal referansi (ikincil). DTC katkisi YOK. Hedef: OBD PID/signal dogrulama (Tesla/Porsche).

YENI KESIF (Brave Search). Volvo/Mack SPN/FMI kaynaklari: classtrucks (Volvo fault codes), vehq (Volvo D13 table), truck-manuals (Volvo FMI), dieselgeneratortech (Volvo engine). Projede src/protocols/j1939/oem/volvo.py decoder VAR. Hedef: J1939 SPN/FMI (Volvo/Mack).

YENI KESIF. J1939DA (Digital Annex) PGN/SPN ingest araci: j1939da-pgn-spn-oct22.tsv -> SQLite DB (j1939-pgn-spn-ingest.py). SA/global-SA ayri sheet'lerden. Bu bir ARAC (J1939DA'dan veri cikarma pipeline'i). J1939DA ticari oldugundan veri kendisi degil, donusturucu. Hedef: J1939 PGN/SPN DB olusturma referansi.
YENI KESIF. J1939 egitim notebook'lari (Address Claim, Digital Annex -> JSON). SystemsCyber/J1939DB ile ayni org. Veri degil egitim/referans. Hedef: J1939 protokol egitimi.
YENI KESIF. J1939 decode kutuphanesi (C 76% + C++ 18%). 26 star, 17 fork. Arac (decode referans implementasyonu). Hedef: J1939 decode referansi.
YENI KESIF. 40 satir: code + cause + severity + suggested_fix. Kucuk ama yapisal (severity + fix alani). Hedef: DTC cause + severity + suggested_fix.

sources.notes: BU TURUN EN KAPSAMLI CIFT-MARKALI KESFI. truck-manuals.net = yuzlerce OEM icin free fault code DTC + wiring diagram + PDF manual arsivi. Volvo MID-seviye (128/130/136...250) + ABS/ACM/APM/EBS/EMS/FMI alt-sayfalari; Cummins (ISX/ISM/ISL/ISC), Cat Forklift, Detroit, PACCAR, International, Mack, Mercedes Trucks (5 sayfa), MAN (A/EBS/ECAS/FFR/ZBR), DAF (12 sayfa), Scania (BMS/COO/SMS/TCO). Projede cummins/caterpillar/detroit/volvo/scania/actros decoder'lari VAR -> dogrudan ilgili. Hedef: J1939 SPN/FMI (tum OEM).

YENI KESIF. Detroit DD15 fault code listesi (DDEC kod 11-87: VSG/Oil/Coolant/TPS/Fuel Temp/Turbo/OilPressure sensor + J1939/J1587/J1922 datalink + EEPROM). Kod -> Fault Location. Hedef: Detroit DD15 fault code mapping (referans).

YENI KESIF. Standart SAE J1939 CAN Database (DBC). SPN 91 (EEC2 61443 - AccelPedalPosition1), SPN 513 (EEC1 61444 - ActualEnginePercentTorque), SPN 111 (EFL_P1 65263 - EngineCoolantLevel), SPN 109 (EngineCoolantPressure), SPN 108 (BarometricPressure), SPN 100 (EngineOilPressure), SPN 190 (EngineSpeed), SPN 84 (WheelBasedVehicleSpeed). Dogrudan DbcSignalDecoder ile eslesir.

YENI KESIF. Tier-1 Heavy Duty J1939 sinyal tanimlari ve cerceve yerlesim spesifikasyonu (spec.py). SPN 183 (LFE 65266 - fuel_rate_lph, 0.05 L/h per bit, 0..3212.75 L/h), SPN 190 (EEC1 61444 - engine speed), SPN 110 (ET1 65262 - coolant temp), SPN 100 (EFL/P1 65263 - oil pressure), SPN 92 (EEC2 61443 - engine load), SPN 102 (IC1 65270 - boost pressure), SPN 173 (IC1 - exhaust gas temp EGT), SPN 1761 (AT1T1I 65110 - DEF level). Fiziksel cerceve yerlesimi (start_bit, bit_len, scale, offset, min_value, max_value) ve sinyal korelasyon grafigi.

YENI KESIF. Tam ISO 14229:2006/2013 UDS standart DID katalogu (0xF180..0xF19F standart DIDs: Boot/App SW, Fingerprints, Session, Spare Part, ECU HW/SW, VIN 0xF190; 0xF2xx periyodik, 0xF3xx dinamik, 0xF4xx-0xF8xx OBD DIDs) ve DTC modelleme (dtc.py: 3-byte DTC ID, 8-flag status byte, 3-bit severity byte, DTC classes A/B1/B2/C, snapshots, extended data). 25+ UDS servis uygulamasi (0x10, 0x11, 0x14, 0x19 ReadDTCInformation, 0x22 ReadDataByIdentifier, 0x27 SecurityAccess, 0x2E WriteDataByIdentifier, 0x31 RoutineControl, 0x34..0x37 Flashing).

YENI KESIF. UDS SID 0x19 (ReadDTCInformation altfonksiyonlari: 0x01 reportNumberOfDTCByStatusMask, 0x02 reportDTCByStatusMask, 0x04 reportDTCSnapshotRecordByDTCNumber, 0x06 reportDTCExtDataRecordByDTCNumber), SID 0x22 (ReadDataByIdentifier), SID 0x2E (WriteDataByIdentifier), CAN-TP ISO 15765-2 (single, first, consecutive, flow control) ve UDS Negative Response Codes (NRC: 0x10, 0x11, 0x12, 0x13, 0x22, 0x31, 0x33, 0x35, 0x36, 0x78).

YENI KESIF. NMFTA (National Motor Freight Traffic Association - ABD Agir Vasita Tasimacilik Birligi) acik kaynak J1939 Source Address tablosu (0..255: 0 Engine, 3 Transmission, 11 Brakes, 33 Body, 49 Cab, 61 Exhaust Emission...), PGN/SPN capraz referansi ve SAE J1939 Digital Annex parser araclari (da_parsers.py, create_j1939db_json.py).

YENI KESIF. CSS Electronics J1939 & J1939-73 DM1 teknik referansi. 29-bit CAN ID ayristirma, PGN yapisi (PDU1 vs PDU2, PGN maskeleri), DM1 (PGN 65226) aktif DTC formati (19-bit SPN bilesenleri SPN-Low 16-bit + SPN-High 3-bit, 5-bit FMI 0..31, CM, OC) ve lamba durum bitleri (Protect Lamp SPN 987, Amber Warning SPN 624, Red Stop SPN 623, MIL SPN 1213). SPN 91, 96, 111, 175, 183, 513 PGN referanslari.

YENI KESIF. CSS Electronics ISO 14229 UDS on CAN (UDSonCAN ISO 14229-3 / DoCAN ISO 15765-2) ve ISO-TP spesifikasyonu. UDS Request/Response cerceve mimarisi, SID 0x10..0x3E, altfonksiyon bayti mantigi, SID 0x19 DTC durum maskeleri (0x02, 0x42 WWH-OBD), standart DIDs (VIN 0xF190), NRC negatif yanit yapisi (0x7F) ve ISO-TP coklu-cerceve (Single Frame, First Frame, Consecutive Frame, Flow Control) akis kontrolu.

YENI KESIF. Apache-2.0 acik kaynak UDS istemci ve ECU simulator paketi. UDS SecurityAccess (0x27) seed-key dogrulama algoritmasi, ISO-TP coklu-cerceve tasima motoru, oturum yonetimi ve otomatik teshis kampanya yurutucusu.

YENI KESIF. Gomulu sistemler icin tasinabilir ISO 14229 UDS C yigini. UDS SID tanimlari (0x10..0x87), NRC negatif yanit kodlari (0x10..0x93), tani oturumu tipleri (0x01 Default, 0x02 Programming, 0x03 Extended, 0x04 Safety), ECU Reset modlari (0x01..0x05) ve ISO-TP katman arayuzu (uds_isotp.h, uds_dtc.h).

t64_evidence.obd-generic-* family: 2586 pages, 400 sampled -> 166 distinct content signatures (42% unique) but duplicates form 15/11/10/10-block groups by subsystem; only 35/400 truly unique. Code-specific symptom text is NOT present for most codes.
t64_evidence.troubleshooting steps: 240 sampled pages -> only 22 distinct step signatures; 66 pages share one identical 5-step procedure. Steps are site boilerplate.
t64_evidence.brand-prefixed pages: 68% unique symptoms but identical cause lists (e.g. audi-p2202 and audi-p2233 share the same 'Actuator mechanical failure / Fuse blown' causes).
t64_evidence.genuinely good minority: Code-specific pages DO exist (obd-generic-p1207, c0108, p0456, caterpillar-451-2) and the 300 already merged in T63 came from this minority.
